claims: title:string (no fallback); badge:string (no fallback); odometerKm:number (fallback 5600 only in HUD, current 70); opening:object; mascot:object; vehicles?:object keyed by ride id; chapters:array.
opening/mascot/chapters assumed present. Direct property access can throw if missing. Root is executable JS, not JSON/schema-validated input.
headline?:string[]; tagline?:string; arc?:string; hero?:{image:string,caption?:string}; props?:PaintSpec[]; place?:{headline,tagline,arc,hero,caption} placement overrides.
Headline fallback [The Field Map of, MAP.badge]. Each optional visual is built only when present. Hero caption is static handwriting; hero image has no chapter tag/click interaction.
font default 700 96px Caveat; ink #3b2f21; x 5.2; y 5.0; h 2.6; tilt -.02.
Headline alignment forced center; no config w/z forwarded.
font default 500 58px Caveat; ink #8a765a; x 5.2; y 6.6; h .8; z .06.
Alignment forced center; no tilt forwarded.
font default 500 52px Caveat; ink #6d5c43; w 1400; x 5.4; y 3.4; h .72; z .06; tilt .015.
Only documented consumed fields are supported.
hero: x 11.3,y 4.7,h 3.1,sway .008. caption: font 500 44px Caveat,ink #8a765a,x 11.3,y 2.85,h .5,z .05.
Hero forces wallPin=true/framed=true. No caption tilt/w forwarded.

mascot.scale default 1.15 (current 1.0); sit/walkA/walkB each {file,h,yOff?=0}; sit.perch?=[-.19,0] interpreted [y,x]. vehicles?[id]:{file,h,yOff?=0,perch?=[0,0],flies?}; current vehicles paver/roller/skidsteer, no flies enabled.
All three mascot poses required. file is relative to assets/. Sprite file may repeat. sit yOff is applied at load but sit Y is subsequently recomputed from sit.h and perch each frame.

id:string; stop?:string; wp?:string; wpX?:number; ride?:vehicle-id; finale?:boolean; art?:PaintSpec[]; props?:PaintSpec[]; prints?:PaintSpec[]; note?:NoteSpec; extraNotes?:NoteSpec[]; aphorism?:WritingSpec; extraWriting?:WritingSpec[]; folder?:Folder.

wpX default 15.2+i*16; waypoint label default WP· + zero-padded zero-based i. stop absent -> no nav button. folder controls note/print clickability; art/props/extraNotes not tagged. finale chapters duplicated at -112.
file:string; x:number; h?:number=3; y?:number; wallPin?:boolean=false; framed?:boolean=false; zBack?:number; sway?:number=.02; flip?:boolean=false; bob?:number=0.

Default z=PATH_Z=2.5; when not wallPin and zBack supplied, z=2.5-zBack. wallPin forces z .03. Unset y uses h/2. prints seed framed:true,sway:.006 but each entry can override. Phase is random inside cutout and not configurable through paintSpec.

lines:string[]; title?:string=null; pin?:string|false|null default #b0503c (false/null disables drawn pin); font?:CSS-font default 600 46px Caveat; w?:number=640; x?:number=cx+2.5; y?:number=5.9; h?:number=2.3; z?:number=.07; tilt?:number= i odd .03 else -.03.

Measured text can expand width; line height 56. ink/paper/pad exist only in noteTexture helper defaults (#3b2f21/#fdf6e6/34) and are NOT passed from NoteSpec; do not document them as working config knobs.

lines:string[]; font?:CSS-font default 600 58px Caveat; ink?:string=#6d5c43; align?:string (center supported; otherwise left); w?:number=1024 via texture helper; x?:number=cx+11; y?:number=6.8; h?:number=1; z?:number=.07; tilt?:number=i odd -.02 else .02.
Text is reduced to fit width using px font regex when too wide; font should contain a px size. Line height 96.
title:string; lede?:string default empty; pairs?:[{before:string,after:string,cap:string}]; photos?:[{file:string,cap:string}].

Relative image URLs prefix assets/. pairs render first with two images and range min0 max100 initial50; photos follow, loading=lazy. Text set via textContent or escaped into HTML. No remote record lookup or file-browser behavior.
window.__worldSeek(v)
v numeric progress target; no validation/clamping in this hook.
Sets targetP only; render loop damps p toward it and wraps progress.
undefined; the block-body arrow function has no return statement. Browser QA/debug helper, not a stable service API.
window.__scene
None (property).
Exposes the live mutable Three.Scene object.
scene reference.
window.__worldState()
None.
Read-only snapshot construction.

{p,targetP,cam:[x,y,z],travelers:{fox:boolean,[vehicleId]:boolean},fox:null|{sitVisible,walkVisible,sitH,walkH,sitY,groupY,scale,topLayer},pending,loaded}. Presence flags mean meshes loaded, not active mode or successful image rights/UX.
window.__openFolder(id)
Existing chapter id whose chapter has folder. Current ids are residential, builders, base, process, recognition, quote.
Looks up chapter and calls openFolder; unknown id is not guarded and can throw.
undefined from openFolder, on success.
window.__ft / window.__ftLast
Optional caller-created object with push method (normally an array); __ftLast stores previous timestamp.
If __ft truthy, each render appends frame delta milliseconds and updates __ftLast. Not created by the app and can grow without bound while set.
No helper return.
p=targetP=0 initially.
Presence -> parseFloat(value) || 0, clamp to [0,.999]; sets current and target before rendering.
Initial seek only; does not persist progress or disable motion.
Absent -> false. Presence only matters: ?qa=false also enables it.
new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('qa')
Hides loader immediately on first animation frame. It does not run assertions, freeze random textures, stop animation or prove all assets loaded.
Wheel / vertical touch swipe
wheel e.deltaY; touchstart first clientY and touchmove delta
targetP += wheel delta*.00007; touch delta*.00007*5. Handlers passive; wheel/touch movement ignored while folder open.
Keyboard route / Escape
ArrowDown, PageDown or Space; ArrowUp or PageUp; Escape when folder open.
Down/PageDown/Space increments targetP .012; Up/PageUp decrements .012. Folder open causes all route key behavior to return; Escape closes folder. No preventDefault or focus trap.
Stops navigation buttons
Click or keyboard-activate the generated button for each truthy chapter.stop; focus alone does not seek/open.
Sample camera curve601 points toward wpX+1, dismiss hint and after1400ms open chapter folder if present. Timers not cancelled/coalesced.
Note/photo tap and cursor
Canvas pointerdown/up with movement distance<8px; pointermove.
Raycast registered clickable meshes; opens nearest hit folder. Hover toggles canvas.hot. Canvas pointermove also updates camera parallax normalized mx/my.
Folder close and comparisons
Visible close button, Escape, or click backdrop itself; before/after range input.
Close removes open class and attempts previous focus restore. Open focuses close. Range min0/max100/default50 updates CSS --cut percentage.
Resize / narrow layout
Window resize; CSS width<=700px.
Recompute FOV/aspect and renderer size. Small CSS hides badge/odometer, reduces stop button sizes; no separate mobile engine.
Contact / fallback links
Static tel: and business HTTPS links; fallback PDF link if WebGL renderer creation throws.
Browser/OS navigation/contact action, not a quote form or app API. Do not activate during source audit.
python3 -m http.server 8098 --bind 127.0.0.1 is the retained documented preview command; no project CLI/env/exit contract; unrun runtime.
Pinned Three.js external import before renderer fallback; font gate errors swallowed; texture errors increment loaded; no app backend.
Fixed span112/bridge10/pathZ2.5/wallH15, cadence15.2+16i, strict first-match ride window pad1.2 length16, seam copies and hard-coded curves.
textContent and escaped attributes/captions; pairs before photos; range0..100 starts50; no focus trap; no path sanitizer/schema/auth boundary.
MIT engine vs separately owned artwork/content; stale upstream exclusions not rights proof; no image-content inspection.
Zack approves company copy/publication; company records remain at owner; developer docs not fact approval.
Public business deployment must exclude private operational handbook and verification data; actual host/exclusion unknown.
Git root lookup failure exits2, otherwise exec external checker with registry/git-root; installation/active config unknown.
Only manifest.json/review.json are exceptions under ignored docs/verification; auxiliary author evidence JSON stays local.

Ordinary authored handbook Markdown/sidebar are not blocked; assets ignored; docs generated/.generated/build/node_modules/.fixture directories ignored recursively, and handbook environment/credential/log/database patterns ignored recursively.
Git ignore is not staging, untracking, independent acceptance or public deployment exclusion.
